history.finding: The 1456.276-second run is batch six only, with 84 false positives and 46 engine failures. The subsequent passing baseline is 951.004 seconds for the same ten checks and source files.

comparison_limits: Historical reports do not contain process CPU time. No CPU speedup ratio can be computed.
The 1456-second historical result failed. The passing 951-second result covered ten batch-six checks, not fifty.

Current benchmark uses the opt-level-1, thin-LTO profiling reference build from the small-workload baseline; historical commands used release with thin LTO and 256 codegen units. This is not a controlled same-build optimization attribution.
Timing processes ran sequentially. Host load was high. One one-second external sample was taken during the failed batch-six run.
Current first-50 oracle is a union of independently recorded outputs at the same Git pin. It has no combined oracle duration.
All sixty rules were not evaluated together; first fifty ran together and batch six ran separately for the historical comparison.

root_cause.capacity: 889 identical quality-contracts-1 errors. The shared producer packs ready demands into a 64 MiB resident arena, without automatic memory partitions. Preparation failure rejects every pending relation.
root_cause.conditional: One quality-conditional-1 source-incomplete error: Session::new checks the total bytes of the all-scope snapshot against maxSourceBytes=32000000 before deriving the syntax-gated file set.
root_cause.memory: The driver prepares all dirty file jobs and SQL sessions before the producer wave. SQL session memory is outside the bounded producer arena.

status: First 50 repository rules pass. Batch six repository evaluation fails. All 60 recorded source corpora pass.

source_corpus.method: Union of passed source-all-60 replay and passed full batch-five Vitest replay, replacing the 181 overlapping batch-five observations with its full 312 observations. Overlap identities and outcomes verified as a multiset; same native binary and policies.
source_corpus.retained_metadata_note: Signed aggregate reporters, synthetic graph observations, original I/O observations and uncaptured-test metadata are not counted as native comparisons. The raw replay metadata is retained locally.

preflight_note: The bounded trials were killed at about 112 seconds, before the user authorized long full runs. They are excluded from completed timings and pass counts. Partial source subgroup reports are not used in the corpus union.
failure_encoding: Failure arrays with more than 100 entries use ordered-repetition objects. Repeat each run.failure run.count times to recover the exact array, including order and multiplicity. Raw report hashes refer to the original driver files.
